newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Thailand's Bangchak receives two offers of Tapis.
newsitem.headline: Thailand's Bangchak receives two offers of Tapis.

text.p: Thailand's Bangchak Petroleum Plc refinery received offers of two cargoes of Tapis crude and one of Murban in its February buying tender, industry sources said on Friday.
The 120,000 barrels per day (bpd) Bangchak refinery also received offers for two cargoes of Middle East heavy sour crude, the sources said.
It did not receive any offers of Oman crude, a widely used crude by the refinery.
Bangchak tendered earlier this week to buy 500,000 barrels of Middle East grades and 600,000 barrels of light sweet Far East grades.
The tender closed on Thursday and offers were valid until 1800 hours Bangkok time (1100 GMT) on Friday.
The sources said the two 450,000-barrel cargoes of Tapis were offered at a market premium of $1.00-$1.10.
The Murban cargo was offered at a premium of more than ADNOC plus 80 cents, which would surpass recent spot market premiums if accepted by the refiner.
